beats.intent: ThinkSR keeps a dense carrier while a compact thought process updates windowed tokens through shared recurrent ticks.
beats.claim: A persistent dense carrier, read and updated by a compact thought process.
beats.narration: The method keeps spatial detail available while moving reasoning into a compact recurrent module. The encoder turns the low-resolution input into dense features. The window step partitions that field without dropping tokens. The DQ-CTM thought process reads and updates the windowed representation. The decoder maps the updated dense carrier back to a super-resolved image. The same DQ-CTM parameters are reused across ticks, so recurrence returns to the thought stage itself.

params.headline: ThinkSR updates dense image features through shared thought ticks
params.note: The recurrence is inside the thought process, not around the full image pipeline.

beats.intent: The carrier equation defines dense features first, then partitions those features into tokens while preserving every token.
beats.narration: The equation names the dense carrier that the rest of the method reads and updates. The encoder maps the low-resolution image into the feature field. The window partition operates on that field and produces the token set without changing the carrier idea.

params.headline: The dense carrier is encoded before it is partitioned

terms.label: encoder applied to the low-resolution image
window partition applied to every dense feature

beats.intent: DQ-CTM-SR is not the smallest model in the comparison; its 1.129 million parameters are second largest among the five methods.
beats.claim: ×4 lightweight super-resolution, average over five benchmarks.
beats.narration: The parameter comparison should be read as a cost, not as the main win. CATANet is the smallest reported model. RFDN is only slightly larger than CATANet. IMDN sits below one million parameters. DQ-CTM-SR uses 1.129 million parameters, making it the second largest of these five. CARN is the largest model in this table.

params.headline: DQ-CTM-SR is the second largest model in this comparison
